answer.answer: Flight, ODIN CHECK_IN for PASS-2B (TYR0-P2-PASS2B-v1, MET 22140, IN_CONTACT). Condition: Spacecraft is in NOMINAL mode, on battery in ECLIPSE, bus 5.0V green, battery 7.26V green, load 0.8A green after shed. SoC is 33.91% YELLOW_LOW - that is BELOW the plan envelope of >35% so we are outside the commanded envelope but still 3.9% above the autonomous LOW_POWER threshold (30%). Payload is OFF as commanded, arrays 0.0A as expected in eclipse, no SAFE, no overcurrent.
